LESSON: READING 5.3.3 COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Reading 5.3.3 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 5.3.3 Comprehension, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two General.

Key inquiry question: How do we show that we have understood what we have read? 2. How can we predict how a story, poem or conversation will end?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 5.3.3 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication: The learner’s ability to speak clearly and effectively is enhanced as they retell the story in their own wor

Values:
Unity: The learner’s cooperation skills are enhanced as the learner participates actively in discussions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skill (self-esteem): The learner’s self-esteem is nurtured as they are able to answer comprehension questions correctly.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Reading for comprehension is essential in all learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Digital texts, assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips, page-turners, adapted digital devices

with filter keys/key guards/larger mouse/head control input devices such as head wand

Other Related Service Providers: Resource person, speech therapist, Learner support assistance, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist.
